items.title: JosssphZhou/poki
items.why: It shows a practical open-source implementation of AI agents controlling real smartphone hardware.
items.summary: Poki is a local Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets AI agents interact directly with an iPhone without needing hardware mods or jailbreaking.

items.title: A Jev that can ask Opus for help gives Opus accuracy at 4x lower cost
items.why: It explains a smart, budget-friendly strategy for leveraging powerful LLMs effectively.
items.summary: Researchers showed that using a smaller, cheaper AI model to draft answers and only consult Claude Opus when stuck matches high accuracy at a fraction of the cost.

items.title: sarpstar/cinecode
items.why: It demonstrates how AI agents can automate creative multimedia projects entirely through code.
items.summary: Cinecode is an open-source tool where an AI agent writes scripts, generates visual frames via code, and builds complete video files automatically.

items.title: shanselman/gputaskman
items.why: If you run local LLMs, this tool helps you monitor GPU VRAM usage and model performance directly from your system.
items.summary: Gputaskman is an open-source GPU task manager for Windows and Linux that tracks VRAM consumption, GPU activity, and LLM KV-cache metrics per process.

items.title: Claude Code's "Don't Ask Again" exposes passwords in 1,122 public GitHub files
items.why: This is a critical security warning if you use AI coding tools alongside Git and GitHub.
items.summary: A flaw involving Claude Code's 'Don't Ask Again' setting caused developer passwords and API keys to be accidentally committed to over 1,000 public GitHub repositories.

items.title: The Components of Agent Memory
items.why: Understanding how AI agents store and recall context is essential when learning to build agentic software.
items.summary: This article breaks down the architectural pieces of agent memory, explaining short-term, long-term, and working memory in LLM systems.

items.title: The end of Microsoft Research's AI Frontiers group
items.why: It highlights major structural shifts happening inside big tech AI research divisions.
items.summary: Microsoft has reportedly disbanded its AI Frontiers research group as part of reorganizing its artificial intelligence teams.

items.title: Iran war live: Blasts heard in Qeshm; US moves to block land supply routes
items.why: It provides essential coverage on escalating global geopolitical conflicts.
items.summary: Iranian state media reported military strikes near key strait and port cities amid expanding regional warfare.

items.title: Israel's president taps opposition candidate, not Netanyahu, to form a government
items.why: It reports on significant political changes in Middle Eastern leadership.
items.summary: Israel's president selected opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot instead of Benjamin Netanyahu to attempt to form the next government coalition.

items.title: US offers $20m reward for information about Iran's nuclear programme
items.why: It highlights major developments in global diplomacy and security policy.
items.summary: The US government offered a $20 million reward for details on Iran's nuclear program amid heightened military tensions.

items.title: What we know so far after Krakow gun attack
items.why: It covers a major international breaking news event in Europe.
items.summary: A mass shooting in Krakow's main square left six people dead before police apprehended the suspect.
